function.arguments: {"finding": "The `biomarker_baseline` column contains a sentinel value of -999.0, which appears in 14 of the 130 severe patients. This value is used to denote missing or invalid data. However, it is not a valid biomarker measurement and should not be included in the mean calculation. Including it skews the mean to a negative value, which is biologically implausible given that the observed valid values are all positive (minimum valid value is 58.175 ng/mL).", "implication": "The mean baseline biomarker value must be calculated using only valid (non-sentinel) values.
